accident_report: Vehicle 1 (V1) is traveling in Lane 2 (second lane from the right) with a vehicle (V4) ahead in the same lane. V1 is behind V4 and ahead of V2. Vehicle 2 (V2) is traveling in Lane 1 (rightmost lane), parallel to V1. Vehicle 3 (V3) is traveling in Lane 3 (third lane from the right), attempting a lane change into Lane 2 where V4 (ahead of V1) is located. V3 makes a sudden lane change into Lane 2 where V4 is ahead of V1. V4 brakes sharply, making V1 swerve into Lane 1 to avoid a rear-end collision with V4. V1 loses control while swerving to Lane 1 where V2 is traveling. V2 makes an evasive maneuver towards the shoulder but still collides with V1 as V1 is swerving out of control. After colliding with V2, V1 continues to lose control and collides with the concrete barrier wall on the right side of Lane 1. This results in a collision where V1 collides with V2 and hits the barrier wall, causing damage to V1 and V2, with V1 taking additional damage from the barrier wall collision.
